english.title: Land owner make false statement in respect of notice under paragraph 4(1) of Schedule 15
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of land at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF LAND..), made a statement in respect of information required by a notice under paragraph 4(1) of Schedule 15 to the Water Resources Act 1991 which you knew to be, or recklessly made such a statement which was, false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY FALSEHOOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 4(2)(b) and (c) and (3) of Schedule 15 to the Water Resources Act 1991.
